transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my wife is the one who wanted me to come in. What finally scared her is that... I keep hearing things. I hear water running, and men whispering inside the walls of the house, but there's nobody there. And sometimes I see this dark, wet patch spreading across the hallway. I'll go over and check it, but the floor is completely dry. It really freaked her out, so she told me I had to come see someone.
How long have you been experiencing these hearing and seeing things that aren't there?

It's been going on for about seven months. It, uh, it started right around the winter freeze. The repairs on the house just... they turned into this huge mess that I couldn't get out from under. That's when I started noticing all of it.
Do the voices you hear, like the men whispering, ever say anything that's related to your mood or how you're feeling at the time?

I... I'm not really sure. I can't usually make out the exact words. It's more like a low mumbling, just whispering back and forth to each other. Like they're having a conversation that I can't quite hear through the drywall. So I haven't really noticed if it has anything to do with my mood or how I'm feeling. It's just always this muffled talking.
Did the problems with the house repairs and the stress that came with it seem to trigger or worsen these experiences of hearing and seeing things?

Yeah, I'd say so. Before the house problems dragged on and I fell into this depression... I never heard voices in the walls or saw wet patches that weren't there. I never thought the neighbors were tracking me, either. Those things only showed up after I had already stopped caring about my usual life and started feeling like a failure every day. It all just started piling up after that.
Have you ever had a period where you didn't hear the voices or see things that aren't there, since they first started?

No, not since they started. Like I was just saying a minute ago, before the house mess really dragged on and I fell into this depression, I never dealt with any of this. I never heard the voices, or saw those wet patches, or worried about the neighbors tracking me. All of that only began after I had already stopped caring about my life and just... felt like a failure all the time. But once those things showed up, no, I haven't had a break from them. They've just been there ever since.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt extremely happy, excited, or irritable, and your wife or others noticed a significant change in your behavior?

No, I've never had anything like that. I've never been overly happy or excited... or had a time where people thought I was acting weird in that way. It's just been this... this heavy feeling, mostly. Just the depression and the other things I mentioned. Nothing like what you're asking about.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely happy or excited for a long time?

No, like I just said a second ago, I haven't ever experienced anything like that. I've never had a period where I felt really happy or excited for a long time. It's really just been the exact opposite for me.
Have you ever felt extremely energetic or active for a period of time?

No, not at all. I've never had a time where I felt super energetic or active. Honestly, it's a struggle just to find the energy to get out of bed or get through a normal day. So, no, nothing like that.
Did you feel depressed before you started hearing the voices and seeing things that aren't there?

Yes, I did. Before the house problems dragged on and I fell into this depression, I never had any of that happen. I never heard voices in the walls, or saw those wet patches that aren't really there, or thought the neighbors were tracking me. 

All of those things... they only showed up after I had already stopped caring about my normal life. It was only after I started feeling like a total failure every single day that the voices and the other stuff started happening. So, yeah, the depression was definitely first.
Did the feeling of being a total failure and not caring about your life come before the voices and seeing things that aren't there started?

Yeah, like I was just saying... yes. That all came first. Before the house problems really dragged out and I fell into this depression, I never dealt with any of that. I never heard the voices in the walls, or saw those wet patches, or thought the neighbors were tracking me. 

All of that only showed up after I had already given up on my usual life. It was only after I was waking up feeling like a total failure every single day that the voices and the other stuff started. So, yes, it definitely came before.
When you hear the whispering or see the wet patches, are they usually related to your feelings of failure or depression?

I'm not really sure if they're related. I mean, the voices are just... whispering about things I can't quite make out, and the wet patches are just there on the walls. I don't know if they have anything to do with me feeling like a failure. They just happen.
When you hear the whispering or see the wet patches, do they ever seem to be related to your feelings of failure or depression?

Like I just said, I... I don't really know. The whispering is just quiet, I can't really hear what they're saying. And the wet spots on the walls, they're just... spots. I don't see how they connect to me feeling so down or like a failure. It's just stuff that's happening around me.
When you hear the whispering or see the wet patches, do they seem to match or reflect how you're feeling at the time?

I mean... I really don't think so. I don't see a connection. Like I was trying to say, the whispering is just... whispering. I can't make out the words. And the walls are just wet. It doesn't feel like it has anything to do with my mood or... or how bad I feel about myself. It's just happening in the house.
Do the voices or visions happen only when you're feeling extremely depressed?

Yeah, I suppose they do. Before the house problems dragged on and I fell into this depression, I never had anything like this happen. I never heard voices in the walls, or saw wet patches that weren’t really there... or thought the neighbors were tracking me. None of that. 

Those things only showed up after I had already stopped caring about my usual life. It all just started happening after I was already feeling like a total failure every single day. So, yeah, it only happens now that I feel this bad.
When the voices whisper or you see the wet patches, are they ever saying or showing something that's related to your feelings of failure or being down?

I... I feel like we keep going in circles with this a bit. Like I said a minute ago, I can't even make out the words. So, no, they aren't saying anything about me being a failure. It's just quiet whispering. 

And the wet patches... they don't show any kind of picture or message or anything like that. They just look like plain old water spots on the wall. I know they only started happening after I got really depressed, but what I'm actually hearing and seeing doesn't seem to be about my mood.
When you hear the whispering or see the wet patches, do they ever seem to be related to your feelings of sadness or hopelessness?

I really don't know how else to answer that, Doc. No. Like I just said, they aren't related to my sadness at all. There's no message in it. The whispering is just noise I can't understand, and the wet spots just look like water on the wall. They don't have anything to do with me feeling hopeless. They're just... there.
Do you think the voices and visions would stop if your depression got better?

I... I really don't know. I mean, I'd like to think they would. Since none of this started until after I got so down about everything, it makes sense that maybe they'd go away if I felt like myself again. But... I've never been through anything like this before. So I really can't say for sure if they'd stop or not. I just don't know.
Has there been any period of time since you started feeling depressed where you felt significantly better?

No, not really. Once I started feeling this down, it just kind of stayed that way. There hasn't been any break where I felt like my old self again or felt significantly better. It's just been a constant heavy feeling the whole time.
Do you think the voices and visions are a part of your depression or separate from it?

I guess... I think they have to be part of it. Before the house problems dragged on and I fell into this whole... depression, I never heard voices in the walls. I never saw wet patches that weren't really there, and I definitely never thought the neighbors were tracking me. None of that happened before. Those things only showed up after I had already stopped caring about my usual life and started feeling like a total failure every day. So, yeah, I think they must be connected.
Have your depressive feelings lasted for at least two weeks?

Yeah, definitely. It's been way longer than two weeks. This has been going on for about seven months now. It all started back when that winter freeze happened and the house repairs just turned into this massive mess that I couldn't get out from under. So, yeah, it's been a long time.
